rule: Text-presence checks may be useful lint or structural evidence but may not be the sole proof for high-value state/write/release invariants. Each listed invariant therefore binds at least one behavioral or acceptance check.

high_value_invariants.claim: UI and read-session code cannot acquire generic GEL tutorial mutation authority.
Archive canonical/candidate writes remain capability-scoped and transaction failure cannot partially commit canonical state.
New omits datetime and uses validated New-form teacher; Revision preserves source timestamp and historical teacher.
Failed typed draft edits leave the prior authoritative in-memory draft unchanged.
Initial HSP/G21/G15 is Rust-owned and unknown historical teacher-comment text is preserved until explicit replacement.
Level regression applies only to New and only to the same canonical semantic role.
Packaging revalidates the exact strict-accepted source fingerprint and performs no build before final archive verification.
Dirty drafts intercept window close and navigation discard requests; session expiry or source drift transitions drafts to stale_source without silent rebinding.
